name: "Choose Your Own Adventure" Ants & Bugs on a Log (Kid-Friendly)

instructions.primary_message: Place peanut butter, cheese spread, and cream cheese each in their own small bowls. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp peanut butter, creamy
2 tbsp cheddar cheese spread
2 tbsp whipped cream cheese spread

instructions.primary_message: Place raisins, dried cranberries, sunflower seeds, and pistachios on a plate, keeping them separate. Set the "ants" and "bugs" aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp raisins
1 tbsp dried cranberries
1 tbsp sunflower seeds
1 tbsp pistachios, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, trim, and cut celery crosswise into 3-inch long sticks. Divide "logs" between four additional plates.
Fill logs with your choice of spread, then mix and match the ants and bugs to line up on top. Show off your creations and enjoy!
